# THE RULE: every player must read every link it ever wrote. Links are pasted into chats and forum posts and
# live forever; the player at the published address is replaced whenever the card page changes. So a link
# format is FROZEN once shipped: a change is a new version (`v2.`), the reader for `v1.` stays, and these lines
# are never edited or re-recorded to make a test pass - only appended to, when a new kind of link appears.
#
# `share_test.odin` decodes each one and compares what it carries (deals, tables, par numbers, CCA targets,
# title, flags) with `golden_links.expected`; `just sims test-player` has the wasm player open each one.
